categories.main_business_segments: Chaozhou Three-Circle (Group) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electronic ceramic components industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of electronic components and advanced materials. Its main product lines include communication components, electronic components and materials, and new materials, serving sectors such as electronics, communications, consumer electronics, industrial electronic equipment, and new energy. The company also develops solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) systems and multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 50 years of R&D experience in electronic ceramic components, mastering ceramic material preparation, forming, sintering technologies, and precision mold design. It emphasizes innovation in MLCC products towards miniaturization, high capacitance, high frequency, high reliability, and high voltage. The company also focuses on SOFC technology, developing high-power, efficient, and reliable fuel cell systems. Manufacturing processes include advanced ceramic material synthesis, precision component fabrication, and integration of new materials and electronic pastes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in electronics, telecommunications, consumer electronics, industrial control, and new energy sectors. The company serves domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales to industrial clients. Major end markets include data centers, cloud computing, IoT, automotive electronics, and energy sectors. The top five customers accounted for approximately 17.55% of total sales in 2023.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with major facilities and subsidiaries in Guangdong (Chaozhou), Sichuan (Nanchong, Deyang), Shenzhen, and other regions. It also has overseas subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Germany, the Netherlands, Malaysia, the United States, South Korea, India, and Thailand, supporting global sales and service networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chaozhou Three-Circle operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and development of electronic components and materials. It controls R&D, production, and sales, providing components to downstream manufacturers in electronics and communications industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and scale expansion to strengthen its core product competitiveness. R&D focuses on high-capacity MLCCs, high-reliability electronic components, and advanced ceramic materials. It actively develops SOFC systems for energy transition and invests in new energy, automotive electronics, semiconductor ceramic structural parts, and biomedical components. The company also emphasizes digital transformation, research center expansion, and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of physical electronic components and materials, including MLCCs, communication parts, and fuel cell systems. The company uses direct sales and distribution channels, with a majority of revenue from direct sales. It also receives government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in the electronic ceramic components industry with strong R&D capabilities and a diversified product portfolio. It holds national high-tech enterprise status and manufacturing champion titles. The industry is highly competitive with increasing domestic substitution of imports, requiring continuous innovation to maintain market share. The company competes with other domestic and international electronic component manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.73 billion, an 11.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.58 billion, up 5.07%. Total assets reached RMB 21.83 billion, growing 11.4%. R&D investment increased by 20.71% to RMB 545.8 million, representing 9.53% of revenue. The company has shown steady growth with expanding production capacity and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chaozhou Three-Circle emphasizes its long-standing expertise in electronic ceramics, advanced manufacturing technologies, and continuous innovation to deliver high-value, high-performance products. Its MLCCs are differentiated by ultra-high capacitance, miniaturization, high frequency, and reliability. The company’s SOFC systems offer industry-leading power density and efficiency, supporting green energy solutions. It also focuses on quality management, customer service, and developing customized solutions to meet evolving market demands.
